blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of the five V22 angle views and six poses: the back-center overskirt remains a raised irregular mass, side views show sharp outward kick-outs, and crouch/sit retain long pointed tails below the seated silhouette. Uniformly splitting sewn edges did not correct the skirt collapse or coverage; no appearance acceptance.
The V22 denser simulation mesh leaves sharp small-scale gathers across both sleeves, shoulders and underarms; the torso also shows irregular surface creases. Surface finish remains rejected.
The posed renders do not establish continuous body clearance, strain, or shorts coverage at inner hip and seat through movement. Fit, deformation and runtime remain unverified and rejected.
Side and arms-up views retain a tall collar profile and pronounced sleeve/underarm gathers. Neck clearance and arm deformation remain unapproved.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
